# Go native fuzz targets of the parsers that read untrusted input: <package under internal/> <FuzzName>...
# A pull request fuzzes (20 s per target) the packages it touched; nightly and `ci:full` fuzz all of them (2 m).
# A new parser that reads untrusted input gets a Fuzz target and a line here (see CONTRIBUTING.md, "Fuzzing").
hook FuzzParse FuzzDecideRewrite FuzzDecideStdin FuzzParseInput FuzzMergeEntries
steer FuzzClaimsDone
redact FuzzCommand
anchor FuzzParse FuzzSetChecked
repoconfig FuzzParse
toolcheck FuzzFromArgv
config FuzzParse
history FuzzReadLast FuzzDecodeRecord
tui/input FuzzParserNeverPanicsAndAlwaysDrains
